and there shall not be any interview.

Weightage is given on the basis of marks obtained in 10+2. An eligible candidate from the family of a retired Anganwadi Worker (AWW) qualifies for an additional two percent points. In case of a tie in merit

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application proforma (Annexure-I), printed with the notice; it can also be had free of cost from the office of the Child Development Project Officer Kunzer.

Fill in the form: Anganwadi Centre sought, Panch Ward/MC Ward and Panchayat Halqa, name and father's name in block letters, marital status and husband's name if married, permanent residence (Mohalla, Village, Panch Ward Constituency, Panchayat Halqa, House No. as per latest Panchayat Ward Electoral, Block), correspondence address, mobile number, date of birth and age as on 01-01-2026.
Enter 10+2 and graduation details (board/school, year of passing, marks obtained, maximum marks, percentage) and state whether you belong to the family of a retired AWW.
Paste a photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer and sign the form and the undertaking.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below, with the affidavit.
Deposit the application in the office of the Child Development Project Officer Kunzer by or before 6 December 2026 and obtain a proper receipt.
Panch Ward Certificate / Electoral Card / present or continuous ward residence certificate issued by BDO (the form's checklist adds "duly countersigned by ACR/SDM").
Domicile Certificate issued by Tehsildar concerned.
Academic Qualification Certificates with Marks card of 10+2.
If the candidate belongs to the family of a retired AWW, copy of document proof (the form names a copy of the e-ration card, for family of retired AWW/AWH).
Non employment Certificate from a Gazetted Officer.
Self-addressed envelope with postage stamp of Rs 5/-.

Affidavit from a first class magistrate stating that all documents submitted are correct and not duplicate or fallacious, that the maximum qualification for Sanginis (AWWs) is graduation and the deponent meets it, and that the deponent has read HR policy no. 222-JK(SWD) of 2022 dated 30.11.2022.
important_instructions: The engagement is on "Honorarium basis". HR policy no. 222-JK(SWD) of 2022 dated 30.11.2022 shall be applicable to the candidate in case of selection as Sangini (AWW). If any document is found incorrect, the candidature may be cancelled and the candidate is liable to action under law. Under the undertaking, the selection committee has the right to reject the application and revoke the engagement order if any content is found incorrect.

content_sections.heading: About CDPO Kunzer
content_sections.text: The Office of the Child Development Project Officer, POSHAN Project Kunzer, works under the Government of Jammu and Kashmir (UT) and runs the Anganwadi Centres of the Kunzer project in Baramulla district. The office can be reached by email at [email protected] and on the contact number 9906666647, both printed on its letterhead.

content_sections.heading: CDPO Kunzer Sanginis (Anganwadi Workers) Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application form with all documents must be deposited by or before 6 December 2026; there is no separate deadline for documents.

rows.event: Last Date to Apply (deposit in office)

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: Both Anganwadi Centres are in the Kunzer project of Baramulla district, one in Turk Batapora and one in Lalpora-A. Only women of the Panch ward or Municipal ward shown against each Panchayat Halqa or Municipal ward may apply for that centre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The criteria for selection remain as envisaged in Govt. Order No 103 JK(SWD) of 2023 dated 28.04.2023: Gender: Women candidates only. Age: Women in the age group of 18-37 years shall be considered. The application form asks for the age as on 01-01-2026. Domicile: The candidate should be a domicile of the UT of J&K. Residence: The candidate should be a resident of the Electoral Ward where the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) is located. Qualification: Minimum education qualification should be 10+2 pass and maximum graduation. Not eligible: Candidates with qualification higher than graduation shall not be considered. The notice does not state any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is purely on academic merit, and there shall not be any interview. Weightage is given on the basis of marks obtained in 10+2. An eligible candidate from the family of a retired Anganwadi Worker (AWW) qualifies for an additional two percent points. In case of a tie in merit, the candidate with higher age will be preferred.

Enter 10+2 and graduation details (board/school, year of passing, marks obtained, maximum marks, percentage) and state whether you belong to the family of a retired AWW. Paste a photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer and sign the form and the undertaking. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below, with the affidavit. Deposit the application in the office of the Child Development Project Officer Kunzer by or before 6 December 2026 and obtain a proper receipt. Panch Ward Certificate / Electoral Card / present or continuous ward residence certificate issued by BDO (the form's checklist adds "duly countersigned by ACR/SDM"). Domicile Certificate issued by Tehsildar concerned. Date of Birth Certificate. Academic Qualification Certificates with Marks card of 10+2. If the candidate belongs to the family of a retired AWW, copy of document proof (the form names a copy of the e-ration card, for family of retired AWW/AWH). Non employment Certificate from a Gazetted Officer. Self-addressed envelope with postage stamp of Rs 5/-. Affidavit from a first class magistrate stating that all documents submitted are correct and not duplicate or fallacious, that the maximum qualification for Sanginis (AWWs) is graduation and the deponent meets it, and that the deponent has read HR policy no. 222-JK(SWD) of 2022 dated 30.11.2022.

faq.question: Q1. How many Anganwadi Centres are covered by CDPO Kunzer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists two Anganwadi Centres: Khimenderpora (Turk Batapora, Ward No. 06) and Sheikh Mohalla Lalpora-A (Lalpora-A, Ward No. 04), both in the Kunzer project of Baramulla.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CDPO Kunzer Sanginis (Anganwadi Workers)?
faq.answer: Applications with documents must be deposited in the office of the Child Development Project Officer Kunzer by or before 6 December 2026 against proper receipt.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Sangini (Anganwadi Worker) post?
faq.answer: Minimum 10+2 pass and maximum graduation. Candidates with qualification higher than graduation shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CDPO Kunzer Anganwadi Workers?
faq.answer: Women in the age group of 18-37 years shall be considered; the application form asks for the age as on 01-01-2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for these Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: Only women who are a domicile of the UT of J&K and a resident of the Electoral Ward where the Anganwadi Centre is located can apply.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an interview for the Sangini (Anganwadi Worker) selection?
faq.answer: No. Selection is purely on academic merit based on 10+2 marks, and there shall not be any interview.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets additional points in the merit?
faq.answer: An eligible candidate from the family of a retired Anganwadi Worker (AWW) qualifies for an additional two percent points.

faq.question: Q8. How is a tie in merit decided?
faq.answer: In case of a tie in merit, the candidate with higher age will be preferred.

faq.answer: Fill the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I), attach self-attested documents and the affidavit, and deposit it in the office of the Child Development Project Officer Kunzer by 6 December 2026 against proper receipt.
